main_text.l: ALba dies, rumpunt quando granaria messem,
Et grata tellus insitum cum fænore
coloni, Redit labori præmium dignum Deo.
Non secus incoctum generoso pectus honesto
Donec parturiens in dias luminis auras
Plaudit, beatam se videns fœtu novo.
Ominor hoc fatum (nec sim tibi vanus Aruspex)
Nec satis: in reliquum diffundet se labor orbem.
Non avidum fallet Lectorem, sed melioris
Doctior ut redeat, maturior Orbis Epoptes,

page.notes: The large woodcut initial "A" is decorative and is shown joined to "Lba" as the first word of the stanza. The line "Non secus incoctum..." is set as a verse stanza; line breaks are kept within each paragraph as printed.
